source: Mark Broadie, 'Assessing Golfer Performance on the PGA TOUR', Interfaces 42(2), 2012; also 'Every Shot Counts' (2014). PGA Tour expected strokes to hole out, from ShotLink data.
verify: Tour values were transcribed for this app. Check each row against the published table before relying on the numbers.
extrapolated: fairway/rough/sand at 5 and 10 yds and green at 1-2 ft are not in the published table; they were extrapolated.

scratch_offset.note: Estimate, not published. Added to every expected value for that lie so a typical scratch round totals about 0. Approx. split per 18: tee 0.9, approach 1.4, around green 0.4, putting 0.4 strokes.
